summary.en: Audiobook library manager with Windows Arm64 setup and zip builds.
summary.zh-TW: 有聲書書庫管理工具，提供 Windows Arm64 安裝程式與 zip。

caveats.en: The release lists Libation.14.2.5-windows-chardonnay-arm64-setup.exe and an arm64 zip; the Classic edition is x64 only. No RTX Spark test is stated.
caveats.zh-TW: 發行頁列出 Libation.14.2.5-windows-chardonnay-arm64-setup.exe 與 arm64 zip；Classic 版只有 x64。頁面沒有 RTX Spark 的測試說明。
